Introduction

Sheon is a South Korean dancer, rapper, and singer signed under MYSTIC Story. She is a member of the girl group Billlie and former pre-debut member of the disbanded girl group bugAboo.

She is also known for participating in Mnet's reality survival show Girls Planet 999.

On November 19, 2021, it was announced that Sheon would be joining Billlie, which had debuted earlier that month.
